description.value: The Rutland Branch is one of 30 locations in the Okanagan Regional Library system, a free public library network serving over 399,000 people across 59,600 square kilometres of British Columbia. The ORL offers physical and digital lending, makerspaces, and a Library of Things tech-lending program. As a publicly accessible community hub in the Rutland neighbourhood of Kelowna, it offers touring cyclists a convenient rest stop along Highway 33 West.
